name: Lightmatter
h1_tail: Funding Rounds, Share Prices and Ownership
description: Lightmatter is privately held and has no ticker. Review the price of each funding round, the investors, funds and SPVs that hold its shares, and the points to confirm before buying or selling.
ledes: Lightmatter is a privately held photonic computing company. Its shares are not listed on an exchange and have no quoted market price; the principal public reference points are the prices at which the company has raised capital. Its most recent financing, a $400 million Series D round announced on October 16, 2024, valued the company at $4.4 billion.

Founded in 2017 and based in Mountain View, California, Lightmatter develops photonic chips that use light to move data between processors in AI data centers. Existing shares change hands in privately negotiated transactions, frequently through special purpose vehicles, and remain subject to the company's transfer restrictions.
figs: Special purpose vehicles with SEC filings naming Lightmatter
table_note: Valuations are as announced by the company, which did not disclose valuations for its Series B and Series C.
round_notes: Lightmatter said the Series D brought its total funding to $850 million and that the proceeds would prepare its Passage chips for deployment in partner data centers. The company has not announced a funding round since October 2024.

A round price reflects what investors paid for the preferred stock issued in that round. Most shares sold by employees are common stock, which carries fewer rights and typically trades at a discount to the preferred price.
investors: New investors advised by T. Rowe Price Associates led the Series D, with participation from Fidelity Management & Research Company and GV. GV and Viking Global Investors led the Series C-2, and Viking Global Investors led the Series B. Other investors include SIP Global Partners, HPE Pathfinder, Lockheed Martin, Matrix Partners and Spark Capital.
spv_sentence: Since 2024, 13 special purpose vehicles formed to invest in Lightmatter have filed with the SEC, five of them in 2026.
funds: Mutual funds and other SEC-registered funds managed by Fidelity and T. Rowe Price reported Lightmatter holdings in filings for periods in 2026. T. Rowe Price's Global Stock Fund valued its position at $14.1 million as of January 31, 2026.
sources: Sources: Lightmatter's announcements of its Series D, Series C-2 and Series B; reports by TechCrunch (May 2023) and Bloomberg (October 2024 and December 2023); and SEC Form D and Form N-PORT filings.
